text:
lee: noticed weird divergence on latency widgets: p50 steady ~60ms, p95 drifting up to 220ms, p99 oscillating between 400ms and 3s over the last hour.
ana: is this across all endpoints or a specific route? could be a tiny client hitting a heavy model variant.
pranav: I filtered by endpoint=/v1/chat and found most p99 jumps come from route=external-proxy with model_variant=large-quant. sample_count for that slice is tiny (~12 in 10m).
lee: aha. merged percentiles in the dashboard make it look like overall tail regressed. when split by route the in-house traffic is fine.
console-team: UX ask: add a compact histogram sparkline next to each percentile so you can eyeball distribution. also show sample_count and a small caution icon if sample_count < 30.
nana: alerting note: alerts-bot currently fires on p99 > 500ms across project. we should short-circuit firing if p99_sample_count < alert_min_samples. propose alert_min_samples = 50.
pranav: agreed. also request backend support for weighted-percentiles when merging across heterogeneous origins (we sometimes combine long cold-start instances with fast cached hits). otherwise merged p99 is meaningless.
lee: what's the simplest incremental change? I vote: 1) add sample_count badge in UI, 2) have alerts check sample_count before paging, 3) add an "inspect" button that opens a route-provenance split.
console-team: we can do the UI pieces. will add microcopy: "Low sample counts make percentiles noisy. Use Inspect to split by route/provenance."
pranav: backend work: add optional query param keep_dimensions=[route,provenance] to rollup API and a param min_bucket_samples for alert evaluation. I'll throw up a small PR.
nana: ops-bot, can you suppress the current p99 alert for the last incident? it's noisy and likely low-sample false positive.
ops-bot: suppressed alert: p99-high-project for 5132101234 by ana.
alerts-bot: noted. I'll update runbook entry to include "check sample_count and split by provenance before paging".
lee: small test command for people to reproduce the split:
```
http "https://telemetry.internal/rollups?endpoint=/v1/chat&since=15m&group_by=route,provenance"
```
should return per-bucket rollups (p50,p95,p99,sample_count) for the window.
pranav: will add a compatibility header so front-end can request both merged and split in one call. console-team: let's coordinate on the contract.
console-team: will open the UI ticket and link the PRs. plan: default view unchanged, add a compact toggle "split by origin".
lee: thanks. once this ships we should add a brief note to the on-call guide about interpreting merged percentiles vs origin-split ones. saves 2am pinging.
nana: agreed. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
